findings.title: Card template's switch to structured reason kinds has no measured or diff-visible rendering test
findings.problem: The dashboard card now groups and counts problem rows using the new 'kind' label and 'skip_count' number instead of reading the display text. Coverage measurement does not include this template. The test changes in this diff only check the data that feeds the card, not the card the user sees. Nothing in the supplied evidence shows a test that renders the card and checks the grouped counts, such as the malformed-records total or the not-evaluated count.
findings.why_it_matters: This template is what the owner sees after each search cycle. If the grouping logic in the template breaks, for example by misreading the new fields or counting rows in the wrong group, the card could show wrong totals and none of the changed tests would catch it, even though the Python side is about 97% covered.
findings.fix_hint: add or point to a rendering test that feeds cycle_grade.html a view containing unevaluated, malformed (per-queue and legacy) and failure rows, then checks the grouped counts and the malformed_total sum

resolved.title: Card template's switch to structured reason kinds has no measured or diff-visible rendering test

resolution.reason: Existing card-render tests in tests/test_app_cards.py exercise the template's kind-based unevaluated, malformed and other branches and the skip_count sum at HEAD. The remaining gap, a test for wording that looks like a skip or not-evaluated message, is reported separately as cov-001 (low).
